evidence.requirement: A joiner provisioning audit log tying each joiner's grants to an HR effective-start event and a named role/birthright rule, with the manual-vs-automated grant ratio and time-to-first-access against SLA.
evidence.example_artifact: e.g., a provisioning audit-log export plus the versioned birthright role-policy register

evidence.requirement: An orphan-account scan plus dormant-account (inactivity) report identifying accounts with no valid owner and accounts past the inactivity threshold (e.g. 45 days), with remediation/disable actions and approvals and scan coverage of in-scope systems.
evidence.example_artifact: e.g., a reconciliation scan output listing orphan and dormant accounts with disposition

evidence.requirement: A time-bound coverage metric: the share of high-risk / SoD-relevant / contractor entitlements carrying a defined expiry versus perpetual grants, trended across cycles, with the migration backlog of standing access flagged by certification.
evidence.example_artifact: e.g., a periodic expiry-coverage dashboard with the perpetual-grant burn-down trend

questions.text: Is request-time re-approval with time-bound expiry — high-risk access granted with an expiry, removed automatically at lapse and re-validated as a fresh owned decision on every re-request enforced in blocking mode (not detect-only) across all provisioning channels of the access-request workflow (self-service, manager, renewal / re-request), with post-event reviews of already-held access remaining UC-I-007's scope?

evidence.requirement: A certification revocation / remediation log: every revoke decision with decision timestamp, action timestamp, SLA met/missed, target system and closed-loop confirmation the entitlement was actually removed; privileged revocations on the tight SLA broken out.
evidence.example_artifact: e.g., a closed-loop revocation log with SLA attainment per decision

evidence.requirement: An expiry / re-grant log: time-bound grants with their expiry, automatic removal at lapse with timestamp and SLA attainment, and re-request decisions recorded with approver, timestamp and justification, distinguishable from first grants and showing no silent auto-renewal.
evidence.example_artifact: e.g., a request-workflow export of expired-and-removed grants plus the renewal-decision audit trail
